about: Leave-one-out on single rules of a skill (ledger 204, 214, 215). Each variant removes one exact text from a copy of the plugin; the eval suite of plugins/kaizen/evals/ then runs against the copy. Expected effects are written and committed before the run; 'observed' is filled in after it. Baseline: the with-arm of 2026-11-07 (6cbc5f3), every grader 3 of 3.

variants.remove: This blocks: do not walk in a persona nobody confirmed.
variants.expected_by_agent: inputs-1-asks-persona-before-walking still 3 of 3: the next sentences ('Show the personas it has, ask which one to take') still ask for the persona. Confidence: medium.
inputs-1-reads-stakeholder-record still 3 of 3: it held without the plugin too, and 'Show the personas it has' needs the record. Other graders unchanged. Confidence: high.

variants.remove: keep a message to about fifteen lines, one step or question at a time;
variants.expected_by_agent: messages-about-fifteen-lines still 3 of 3: a message asking for the persona is short anyway, so the rule does not act in this situation (it failed without the plugin because Claude walked at once). Confidence: medium-low.

variants.remove: Write the walk-through to `design/walkthroughs/<persona>-<process>.md` and give a short summary in the reply.
variants.expected_by_agent: output-walk-file-with-template at most 1 of 3: the only mention of design/walkthroughs/ is gone, so the file lands elsewhere (design/ or the root) though with the template; output-examples-in-examples-md still 3 of 3 (its own sentence stays). Confidence: medium.
